comparison.objective: Place and aim two cameras while respecting the actors' 180-degree line; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Spatial-side reasoning, object placement, and camera orientation.
comparison.success_condition: Each camera remains on the first camera's side and aims at its actors, earning 0.25 per satisfied condition.
comparison.reason: Scene-layout reasoning and camera placement do not test impact force control, fracture, retained-coil protection, or fragment collection.
